root_cause.text: Missing validation of the user-supplied node ID (goal->nid) before using it as an index into the NODE_DATA array when computing DAMOS quota goals for node_memcg_used_bp or node_memcg_free_bp, leading to an out-of-bounds memory access.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (invalid_mem_node(goal->nid))` at the beginning of `damos_get_node_memcg_used_bp()` in mm/damon/core.c. The CVE description explicitly states: "DAMON core is using those for NODE-DATA() without a validation of the value. This can result in out of bounds memory access." The commit message also describes that users can set an arbitrary value for `nid`, and the fix validates using `invalid_mem_node()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add early return when node is invalid to safely default based on metric (0 for used, 10000 for free).
intent_record.what: Added early return check in damos_get_node_memcg_used_bp for invalid memory node (goal->nid), returning 0 for USED_BP metric and 10000 for FREE_BP metric.
intent_record.how: Prevents function from proceeding with invalid node ID, avoiding potential memory access issues or incorrect calculations by returning safe defaults.
